high_findings: IW-SR-001 (High): Industry West legacy search has no natural-language intent handling - 9/9 intent queries return zero; 64% of the 50-query pack zero-result.
IW-SR-002 (High): Industry West search is synonym-blind (guardrail-proven recall misses).
SB-SR-001 (High): Seven Bonde new search trades precision for recall - 39% of returned results not relevant (mean grade 1.78 vs IW 2.69); judge-validated.
notes: Old-vs-new furniture search relevance focused on Industry West and the Seven Bonde Shopify store it is replatforming to (301 redirect confirmed; catalog re-hosted). Seven Bonde nearly doubles reach (38% zero-result vs 64%) but at a precision cost (39% junk); Industry West is precise-but-narrow (NDCG 0.944, 100% relevant when answered). Both fail natural-language intent and fine material attributes. MDE discipline restored after operator flagged an unlinked claim: evidence-backed findings recorded, judge gold-validated, standing weak claim corrected. Report and dashboard wiring deferred.
